title: Chevening Scholarship 2027/2028 (Uganda)
description: Fully funded one-year master's scholarships in the United Kingdom for future leaders from Uganda with at least two years of work experience and an unconditional UK university offer by the stated date.

additionalRequirements: Return to Uganda for at least two years after the award.

applicationInstructions: Apply online through the official Chevening portal. The application is free.
deadlineQuote: Applications close at 12:00 GMT on 12 January 2027.
ugandanEligibilityQuote: Uganda is one of the countries and territories eligible to apply for a Chevening scholarship.
